exports.name: LoadingComponent
exports.summary:
A circular or linear loading indicator, usable standalone or driven by {@link LoadingDirective}
/ {@link LoadingService} (full-screen, overlay, or in-place replace strategies).
exports.summaryZh: 圆形或线性加载指示器，可独立使用，也可由 {@link LoadingDirective} / {@link LoadingService}驱动（支持全屏、遮罩层、原地替换等策略）。

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description:
The CSS height to apply to the host (`undefined` for overlay/full-screen styles, which
fill their container).
methods.descriptionZh: 应用到宿主的 CSS 高度（覆盖层/全屏样式下为 `undefined`，因为它们会填满容器）。

methods.name: getCircleDiameter
methods.description: The current circular spinner diameter.
methods.descriptionZh: 当前圆形加载指示器的直径。

methods.name: getCircleStrokeWidth
methods.description: The circular spinner's stroke width, derived from its diameter.
methods.descriptionZh: 圆形加载指示器的描边宽度，根据其直径推导得出。

methods.name: isCircular
methods.description: Whether the indicator is rendered as a circular spinner.
methods.descriptionZh: 该指示器是否以圆形样式渲染。

methods.name: isLinear
methods.description: Whether the indicator is rendered as a linear progress bar.
methods.descriptionZh: 该指示器是否以线性样式渲染。

methods.name: isFullScreen
methods.description: Whether the indicator is displayed using the full-screen presentation style.
methods.descriptionZh: 该指示器是否以全屏展示样式显示。

methods.name: isOverlay
methods.description: Whether the indicator is displayed using the overlay presentation style.
methods.descriptionZh: 该指示器是否以覆盖层展示样式显示。

methods.name: show
methods.description: Starts in animation and returns an observable for completition event.
methods.descriptionZh: 执行 `show`，用于显示。

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Starts out animation and returns an observable for completition event.
methods.descriptionZh: 执行 `hide`，用于隐藏。

properties.name: animation
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `animation`（类型：`boolean`），用于存储或配置动画（默认值：`false`）。

properties.name: content
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `content`（类型：`TemplatePortal<any>`），用于存储或配置内容。

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Sets mode of [DuiLoadingComponent] to LoadingMode.Determinate or LoadingMode.Indeterminate
properties.descriptionZh: 设置加载指示器为确定模式（LoadingMode.Determinate）或不确定模式（LoadingMode.Indeterminate）。

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The loading indicator's current mode (determinate or indeterminate).
properties.descriptionZh: 加载指示器当前的模式（确定或不确定）。

properties.name: value
properties.description: Sets value of [DuiLoadingComponent] if mode is 'LoadingMode.Determinate'
properties.descriptionZh: 当模式为 'LoadingMode.Determinate' 时，设置加载指示器的进度值。

properties.name: value
properties.description: The loading indicator's current progress value (used in determinate mode).
properties.descriptionZh: 加载指示器当前的进度值（用于确定模式）。

properties.name: style
properties.descriptionZh: 加载指示器的展示样式：全屏、覆盖层或无（内嵌）。

properties.name: height
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `height`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置高度（默认值：`100`）。

properties.name: type
properties.description:
type: LoadingType
Sets type of [DuiLoadingComponent] rendered.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `type`（类型：`LoadingType`），用于存储或配置类型（默认值：`LoadingType.Circular`）。

properties.name: color
properties.description:
color: primary' | 'accent' | 'warn'
Sets theme color of [DuiLoadingComponent] rendered.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `color`（类型：`'primary' | 'accent' | 'warn'`），用于存储或配置颜色（默认值：`'primary'`）。

exports.name: LoadingDirective
exports.summary:
Structural-style directive that shows a {@link LoadingComponent} over/instead of its host
element until the `duiLoadingUntil` condition becomes truthy.

inputs.description: Unique name for this loading instance, auto-generated if omitted.
inputs.descriptionZh: 本加载实例的唯一名称，省略时自动生成。

inputs.name: until
inputs.description: Shows the loading indicator while this value is falsy; hides it once truthy.
inputs.descriptionZh: 当该值为假时显示加载指示器；变为真值后隐藏。

exports.name: LoadingFactory
exports.summaryZh:
低层工厂，为三种加载展示样式（全屏覆盖、定位覆盖、原地替换）创建并管理
{@link LoadingComponent} 实例；供 {@link LoadingService} 内部使用。

methods.name: createFullScreenComponent
methods.description:
Creates a full-screen loading overlay, shown/hidden based on the returned ref's
registration counter.
methods.descriptionZh: 创建全屏加载覆盖层，其显示/隐藏由返回的 ref 的注册计数器驱动。

methods.name: createOverlayComponent
methods.description:
Creates a loading indicator that overlays the given template's content in place,
shown/hidden based on the returned ref's registration counter.
methods.descriptionZh: 创建一个覆盖在给定模板内容之上的加载指示器，其显示/隐藏由返回的 ref 的注册计数器驱动。

methods.name: createReplaceComponent
methods.description:
Creates a loading indicator that swaps in place of the given template's content while
loading, restoring the original content once resolved.
methods.descriptionZh: 创建一个在加载期间取代给定模板内容位置的加载指示器，解析完成后恢复原有内容。

exports.name: LoadingMode
exports.summary: Enumeration `LoadingMode` defining supported loading mode constants.
exports.summaryZh: 枚举 `LoadingMode`，定义支持的加载中模式常量集合。

properties.name: Determinate
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `LoadingMode.Determinate` = 'determinate'，表示Determinate。

properties.name: Indeterminate
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `LoadingMode.Indeterminate` = 'indeterminate'，表示半选状态。

properties.name: entryComponents
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `entryComponents`（类型：`any`），用于存储或配置条目组件列表（默认值：`EXT_LOADING_ENTRY_COMPONENTS`）。

exports.name: LoadingService
exports.summary:
Manages named loading indicators: a full-screen one created at startup, plus any number
of directive-driven (overlay or replace-strategy) loading components registered/resolved by name.
exports.summaryZh:
管理具名的加载指示器：启动时创建的一个全屏指示器，以及任意数量由指令驱动
（overlay 或 replace 策略）、按名称注册/解析的加载组件。

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description:
Creates a directive-driven loading component (overlay or replace strategy, per `config.strategy`),
registered under `config.name`.
methods.descriptionZh:
创建由指令驱动的加载组件（根据 `config.strategy` 采用覆盖层或原地替换策略），
以 `config.name` 注册。

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates (or recreates) a full-screen loading component under the given name.
methods.descriptionZh: 以指定名称创建（或重建）一个全屏加载组件。

methods.name: removeComponent
methods.description: Unsubscribes and destroys the named loading component.
methods.descriptionZh: 取消订阅并销毁指定名称的加载组件。

methods.name: register
methods.description:
Increments the named loading indicator's pending-operation counter, showing it while
the counter is above zero. Retries via `setTimeout` if the component isn't created yet.
methods.descriptionZh:
增加指定名称加载指示器的"待完成操作"计数器，计数大于零时显示指示器。
若组件尚未创建，会通过 `setTimeout` 重试。

methods.name: resolve
methods.description:
Decrements the named loading indicator's pending-operation counter, hiding it once
it reaches zero.
methods.descriptionZh: 减少指定名称加载指示器的"待完成操作"计数器，计数归零时隐藏指示器。

methods.name: resolveAll
methods.description: Immediately resets the named loading indicator's pending-operation counter to zero, hiding it.
methods.descriptionZh: 立即将指定名称加载指示器的"待完成操作"计数器归零并隐藏它。

methods.name: setValue
methods.description:
Sets the named loading indicator's progress value (only takes effect in determinate mode
while it's currently shown).
methods.descriptionZh: 设置指定名称加载指示器的进度值（仅在确定模式且当前正在显示时生效）。
